\section[(dialogue)]{The body, family and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R66-first-pass-the-body-family-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an answer and a word.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a foot, the head, hair, a tooth, the throat
  \item the stomach, a finger, a lip, the face, a knee
  \item the back, the tongue, an eye, the nose, the heart
  \item a fever, ill, pain, medicine, hunger
  \item happy, sad, a doctor, a son, a daughter
  \item an uncle, an uncle, a boy, a girl, a man
  \item a woman, a neighbour, a guest, a teacher, to eat
  \item to drink, to go, to come, to see, to hear
  \item to sit, to sleep, to get up, to walk, to run
  \item to play, to sell, to give, to take, to keep
  \item to open, to laugh, to cry, to sing, to dance
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A foot? (\textbf{\mw{पग}}, \emph{pag}.) The head? (\textbf{\mw{माथो}}, \emph{mātho}.) Hair? (\textbf{\mw{बाळ}}, \emph{bāḷ}.) A tooth? (\textbf{\mw{दांत}}, \emph{dānt}.) The throat? (\textbf{\mw{गळो}}, \emph{gaḷo}.) The stomach? (\textbf{\mw{पेट}}, \emph{peṭ}.) A finger? (\textbf{\mw{आंगळी}}, \emph{āṅgḷī}.) A lip? (\textbf{\mw{होठ}}, \emph{hoṭh}.) The face? (\textbf{\mw{मूंडो}}, \emph{mū̃ḍo}.) A knee? (\textbf{\mw{गोडो}}, \emph{goḍo}.) The back? (\textbf{\mw{पीठ}}, \emph{pīṭh}.) The tongue? (\textbf{\mw{जीभ}}, \emph{jībh}.) An eye? (\textbf{\mw{आंख}}, \emph{ā̃kh}.) The nose? (\textbf{\mw{नाक}}, \emph{nāk}.) The heart? (\textbf{\mw{दिल}}, \emph{dil}.) A fever? (\textbf{\mw{ताव}}, \emph{tāv}.) Ill? (\textbf{\mw{बीमार}}, \emph{bīmār}.) Pain? (\textbf{\mw{दरद}}, \emph{darad}.) Medicine? (\textbf{\mw{दवाई}}, \emph{davāī}.) Hunger? (\textbf{\mw{भूख}}, \emph{bhūkh}.) Happy? (\textbf{\mw{राजी}}, \emph{rājī}.) Sad? (\textbf{\mw{उदास}}, \emph{udās}.) A doctor? (\textbf{\mw{डाक्टर}}, \emph{ḍākṭar}.) A son? (\textbf{\mw{बेटो}}, \emph{beṭo}.) A daughter? (\textbf{\mw{बेटी}}, \emph{beṭī}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\mw{काको}}, \emph{kāko}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\mw{मामो}}, \emph{māmo}.) A boy? (\textbf{\mw{छोरो}}, \emph{chhoro}.) A girl? (\textbf{\mw{छोरी}}, \emph{chhorī}.) A man? (\textbf{\mw{आदमी}}, \emph{ādmī}.) A woman? (\textbf{\mw{लुगाई}}, \emph{lugāī}.) A neighbour? (\textbf{\mw{पाड़ोसी}}, \emph{pāṛosī}.) A guest? (\textbf{\mw{पावणो}}, \emph{pāvṇo}.) A teacher? (\textbf{\mw{मास्टर}}, \emph{māsṭar}.) To eat? (\textbf{\mw{खाणो}}, \emph{khāṇo}.) To drink? (\textbf{\mw{पीणो}}, \emph{pīṇo}.) To go? (\textbf{\mw{जाणो}}, \emph{jāṇo}.) To come? (\textbf{\mw{आवणो}}, \emph{āvṇo}.) To see? (\textbf{\mw{देखणो}}, \emph{dekhṇo}.) To hear? (\textbf{\mw{सुणणो}}, \emph{suṇṇo}.) To sit? (\textbf{\mw{बैठणो}}, \emph{baiṭhṇo}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\mw{सोवणो}}, \emph{sovṇo}.) To get up? (\textbf{\mw{उठणो}}, \emph{uṭhṇo}.) To walk? (\textbf{\mw{चालणो}}, \emph{chālṇo}.) To run? (\textbf{\mw{दौड़णो}}, \emph{dauṛṇo}.) To play? (\textbf{\mw{खेलणो}}, \emph{khelṇo}.) To sell? (\textbf{\mw{बेचणो}}, \emph{bechṇo}.) To give? (\textbf{\mw{देणो}}, \emph{deṇo}.) To take? (\textbf{\mw{लेणो}}, \emph{leṇo}.) To keep? (\textbf{\mw{राखणो}}, \emph{rākhṇo}.) To open? (\textbf{\mw{खोलणो}}, \emph{kholṇo}.) To laugh? (\textbf{\mw{हंसणो}}, \emph{hãsṇo}.) To cry? (\textbf{\mw{रोवणो}}, \emph{rovṇo}.) To sing? (\textbf{\mw{गावणो}}, \emph{gāvṇo}.) To dance? (\textbf{\mw{नाचणो}}, \emph{nāchṇo}.)
